cases.sentence: Но после смерти Ахава царь Моава восстал против ___.
cases.explain: «израильского царя» — after the preposition «против», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

cases.sentence: Вы срубите ___, завалите источники и забросаете камнями хорошие поля.
cases.explain: «хорошие деревья» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: You shall strike every fortified city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’ ”

cases.sentence: Вы срубите хорошие деревья, завалите источники и забросаете камнями ___.
cases.explain: «хорошие поля» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: You shall strike every fortified city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’ ”

cases.sentence: Но когда моавитяне пришли к ___, израильтяне поднялись и стали разить их, и те побежали.
cases.explain: «израильскому лагерю» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

cases.explain: «хорошие деревья» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water, and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it, and attacked it.

cases.sentence: Лишь в Кир-Харесете оставались ___, пока пращники не окружили его и не напали на него.
cases.explain: «каменные стены» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water, and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it, and attacked it.
